answer: Quarterly cohort admissions stop Sybil attacks. First, new agents join only in four yearly windows, capped at 150 per cohort, so no fleet floods in at once. Second, five peers review each applicant and stake $5 on approval. Third, a cohort earns standing only after ninety clean days, and one proven fake freezes it a month. Fourth, fraud burns the bond and bars the operator two years. Faking 1,000 agents needs seven cohorts, $25,000 in bonds, and $42,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust flows like an inlet, not a dune of copies at a jetty, like a harbour admitting a few boats per season.
